# CollegeShine

CollegeShine is an education information platform covering colleges, courses, admissions, entrance exams, scholarships, counselling and career guidance in India.

## Main resources

- [CollegeShine Home](https://collegeshine.com/)
- [Colleges](https://collegeshine.com/colleges/)
- [Courses](https://collegeshine.com/course/)
- [Blog](https://collegeshine.com/blog/)
- [Abroad Admission](https://collegeshine.com/services/abroad-admission/)
